_note: DRAFT cases written by Claude for T-08, to be reviewed by Monika / a teacher (quality.md asks for 25 patterns). Each case is one child's week on the real curriculum graph (data/curriculum/grade3-maths.json): missed = lessons missed this week in teaching order; lastTaught = the class's latest confirmed lesson (next week = the 5 lessons after it in the book). Code computes the candidate set; best = the target a teacher would pick first; alsoAcceptable = other targets that count. Pass = Claude's choice (not the rule), targets ⊆ candidates, and best or an acceptable one among the targets. Updated 1 Nov for the 2026-27 book (T-81): cases rechecked against its graph; face value, check-by-adding and 4-digit numbers are gone, and a lesson without a practice rule (e.g. M3.NUM.SEQUENCE) is never a candidate.
